trechos: After oral contraceptive withdrawal bleeding on day 3 of cycle, recombinant FSH or hMG 300-450 IU/day will be initiated and letrozole (Femara, Novartis, East Hanover, NJ) 5 mg/day will be administered for 5 days.
trechosPt: Após sangramento de abstinência do contraceptivo oral no dia 3 do ciclo, FSH recombinante ou hMG 300-450 UI/dia será iniciado e letrozol (Femara, Novartis, East Hanover, NJ) 5 mg/dia será administrado por 5 dias.
